rating_definitions.Excellent: Accurate bounded instruction, worked practice, transfer assessment and current evidence all reviewed; no original item receives this merely for breadth.
rating_definitions.Good: Coherent scope or structure with usable design; specified teaching/evidence work remains.
rating_definitions.Partial: Concept present but explanation or practice incomplete.
rating_definitions.Weak: Mention, inherited citation or unverified annotation provides little direct teaching/evidence.
rating_definitions.Missing: No original item; new omission recorded in gap/checklist register.
